gens: As a care coordinator, I want to generate reports on recurring appointments, so that I can analyze trends.
As an account holder, I want to view my monthly reports, so that I can manage my finances effectively.
As an account holder, I want to receive notifications about upcoming transactions, so that I can plan my day.
As a site manager, I want to schedule material requests, so that I can manage resources effectively.
As an infrastructure developer, I want to be able to deploy a new version of an app that generates reports/datasets.
